# harness_platform_authentication_settings (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving the account level authentication settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harness_platform_authentication_settings" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `absolute_session_timeout_minutes` (Number) Users are logged out after this many minutes regardless of activity.
- `authentication_mechanism` (String) Authentication mechanism configured for the account, e.g. `SSO` or `NON_SSO`.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `public_access_enabled` (Boolean) Whether public access is enabled for the account.
- `session_timeout_minutes` (Number) Users are logged out after this many minutes of inactivity.
- `two_factor_enabled` (Boolean) Whether two-factor authentication is enforced for all users in the account.
- `whitelisted_domains` (Set of String) List of whitelisted domains for the account.
